note: Written BEFORE any LAB-06 code. Every clause of the LAB-06 tasks, guide 9.1-9.5, guide 7.4 (bank) and T45-T52. The audit script reads THIS file, so the audit cannot drift from the plan.
clauses: horizon chosen from strategy/holding diagnostics at development; 7 calendar days for the pilot or another registered horizon
only a COMPLETE outcome may be used; open positions marked under the same account contract, not just closed wins
overlapping extension carries purge and dependence corrections
bank only from discoveries BEFORE the cutoff
effective duplicates merged for coverage, but trial rows are never deleted
retired params still serve open campaigns
weighted paired delta with the guide 9.2 kernel
support diagnostics: N_eff, contiguous episode count, autocorrelation/block, per-episode contribution
context distance and group weights are train-only
episodes are NOT selected because their outcome was good
supporting episode IDs and weights returned with every recommendation
the quality gate may reject everything; no best-of-bad is forced into a trade
model fit 28d and inference 4h as the registered hypothesis
bank refresh on the baseline calendar
switch assessment at every eligible 4h boundary when needed
a triggered-refresh variant is a SEPARATE variant
bank training utilities carry an initial-state contract
a live switch pays transition cost and delay against the ACTUAL current campaign
no hypothetical reset-flat expert curve is used as deploy equity
record why response uncertainty cannot capture all state-dependent execution risk
episode table carries every field guide 9.1 lists
an outcome may only be used at T when end + publication/processing delay <= T
no response label built from future PnL is fed into a regime fit at episode_start
candidate creation time is replayed in the nested experiment
kernel w = exp(-d^2/2h^2) * exp(-(t-e)/tau) * q_e with q_e an ELIGIBILITY, never an outcome bonus
h, tau and feature weights chosen inner-only
episodes sharing a label are not collapsed as interchangeable when contexts differ
N_eff is reported as weight concentration, NOT as an independent observation count
insufficient episodes returns a status and keeps the incumbent
utility is net return on a fixed allocation minus registered penalties
relative SE from paired contiguous blocks, not iid bars
transition cost from projected turnover, fees, slippage and residual handling, in the same units
the switch rule is the guide 9.3 inequality
C_transition is never double-charged into actual PnL
four clocks are separate with their own counters
a familiar market state transition does not mean the model is broken
the retrain detector reads covariate fit/novelty only, not strategy performance
a refit job keeps the cutoff fixed at its trigger
coalesce/cancel/supersede is deterministic; a stale job never uses undeclared future inputs
the incumbent operates while a refit is pending
an entry campaign carries an immutable entry_parameter_digest
an open trade stays protected by the params it entered with
activation waits for flat/terminal; requested time and actual delay are both recorded
new candidate indicators must be warm and causal before activation
no EMA/HMA reset per switch and no adaptive-length state carried across params without a contract
a long-open campaign is reported stale/transition-blocked, never force-closed
retired parameter versions survive while orders reference them
a specialist is not dropped only because the pooled mean is lower
the bank at T contains no candidate discovered after T
bank version carries entry/retire dates, adapter hash, parameter digest, validation panel, status, warmup readiness and reason
an unfinished outcome may not be used at decision T
a candidate discovered after the inner cutoff never appears in the inner pseudo-live bank
incumbent and challenger get the same economics, initial state and horizon
when one episode dominates the similarity, support/uncertainty warns and it shrinks or falls back
refit latency and out-of-order jobs cause no early or backdated activation
a switch while a campaign is open keeps the old protective version or migrates explicitly
unwarmed indicators cause wait/fallback, never a reset that fabricates signals
model fit, bank refresh and switch counters stay distinct with no recursive trigger storm
every keep/switch carries evidence, data cutoffs and consistent units
the technical pass does not depend on there being many switches; zero switches from insufficient edge is a valid result
